mapper.select: SELECT set_config('app.tenant_id', CAST(#{tenantId} AS TEXT), true)

SELECT event_id AS eventId, tenant_id AS tenantId, topic, ordering_key AS orderingKey, event_snapshot::TEXT AS eventSnapshot, claimed_by AS claimedBy, attempt_count AS attemptCount FROM tenant_access_outbox_events WHERE event_id = #{eventId}
mapper.update: UPDATE tenant_access_outbox_events SET published_at = #{publishedAt}, claimed_by = NULL, claimed_until = NULL, last_failure = NULL WHERE event_id = #{eventId} AND claimed_by = #{claimant} AND published_at IS NULL

UPDATE tenant_access_outbox_events SET claimed_by = NULL, claimed_until = NULL, next_attempt_at = #{retryAt}, last_failure = #{failureSummary} WHERE event_id = #{eventId} AND claimed_by = #{claimant} AND published_at IS NULL
